Main menu
Controls & information

Click a portrait or worker to select. Shift-click or Ctrl-click a portrait toggles a merc; Shift-drag on the map selects a group. Ground clicks move the group. Walk / Run / Sneak and stance changes apply to the selected group.

WASD / arrows or drag to pan. Q / E rotate the camera. Scroll to zoom. Right-click for context actions. Keys 1–6 choose the interaction level. The stance silhouettes open Stand / Kneel / Crawl; the backpack opens Inventory, free to look. Reload and weapon swap affect that character.

Run: 50% less AP, double speed. Sneak: 50% more AP, half speed, +20 stealth.

Easy reveals exteriors. Room interiors stay hidden until observed; opponents still require visual awareness. ? marks a glimpse or remembered position.
